overall_safety_summary: The kitchen scene is mostly clear, but the saucepan handle is pointing outwards, presenting a risk of accidental bumping and spills.

hazards.description: The handle of the saucepan on the stove is pointing outwards towards the front-right edge.
hazards.explanation: An outward-facing handle can easily be bumped, leading to the pot tipping over and spilling hot contents.
hazards.older_adult_relevance: Older adults with mobility or balance challenges are at a higher risk of accidentally knocking into protruding handles, which can cause severe burns or scalds.
hazards.recommended_action: Turn the saucepan handle inward so it is positioned safely over the stovetop and cannot be easily bumped.

uncertainties: Whether the stove burner is active and heating the saucepan.
Whether the lid knob is hot to the touch when handled with bare hands.
